verdict.rationale: Data export and portability is a fair question for a work-management SaaS, so the axis applies. Nothing in the pack documents a bulk or full-account export feature, open export formats (such as CSV, JSON or Excel), or an offboarding path. The GraphQL API, MCP server and 2-way sync integrations are developer building blocks that could be used to build an export, not a documented export capability, so they earn no credit.
